security_justification.audit_integrity: Maintains complete auditability. Adds explicit diagnostic logging of runner execution environment in CI logs and preserves all governance checks.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Does not modify, touch, or interact with any authentication, authorization, or token validation mechanisms.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Derives public change and runner diagnostics only; no cryptographic signing or identity authority logic is altered.
security_justification.concurrency: Executes synchronously during workflow step execution with no concurrent race conditions or shared mutable state.
security_justification.confidentiality: Diagnostic step logs only non-sensitive runner properties (hostname, CPU count, available parallelism, and cache directory path); no secrets or tokens are exposed.
security_justification.cryptography: Does not introduce, alter, or interact with cryptographic operations or key material.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Diagnostic logging prints basic hardware parallelism and cache paths; no internal credentials, tokens, or system secrets are disclosed.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Operates independently using local Node.js os module and built-in runner cache; makes no external network calls or security service integrations.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fails closed if the diagnostic script encounters an error; build ignore patterns prevent unvetted build artifacts from entering version control.
security_justification.lifecycle: Diagnostic step executes once during the sdk CI job setup lifecycle before test execution commences.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Confined strictly to CI workflow configuration and client-evidence-browser .gitignore; introduces no runtime or production code mutations.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Does not process or transform user telemetry, personal data, or sensitive operational payloads.
security_justification.resource_retention: Retains no persistent buffers, memory handles, or connections beyond the execution of the diagnostic command.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Deterministic and idempotent; re-running the diagnostic step produces identical reporting without side effects.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Runs entirely within the runner execution environment and does not alter any trust boundaries or permission perimeters.
